title: Nine Feet of Mending
subtitle: 链条与锁链 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 链条与锁链（生活与学习·器物与工具）
meta: 主题语境：链条与锁链（生活与学习·器物与工具）　|　核心词汇：chain　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chain 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 my mother was sent to mend ① chain she could not lift, and she said the mending was the whole of the lesson. The ② chain, meaning the links and not the lock, was nine feet long and was mended by whoever came last; chain, she said, is the only thing in a yard that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chain in that yard had the same link, and the ④ chain at the end, meaning the one the smith kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever mended properly. Chain, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chain was the whole of the trade, meaning the connection it carried and not the links. The ⑥ chain, meaning the connection and not any of that, is the only thing in a trade that everybody depends on and nobody questions; chain, he said, is either something you mend or the only word that means both links and a connection. She said the connection is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ chain had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the link. The ⑧ chain of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine feet and eleven years of mending; chain, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chain I remember is the one at the end, which was mended in 1968 and is still described as the strongest in the county. A ⑩ chain, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being mended; every chain, she said, is a connection that has agreed to look like links. She said the connection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 链条（指那些链环本身，与那把锁相对）
C. 固定搭配：mend a chain 修补一条链子
D. n. 链条（指院子里每一条）
E. n. 链条（指末尾那一条）
F. n. 连锁（抽象：它承载的那条联系）
G. n. 那条联系（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chain, meaning the links and not the lock
chain was the whole of the trade
the chain had become a number in a report
The chain of the whole thing
A chain, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: mend a chain 意为“修补一条链子”，1948 年母亲被派去修补她抬不动的那条链子。
chain 意为“链条、锁链”，指那些链环本身而不是那把锁，长九英尺，由最后来的人修补。
chain 指院子里每一条链子，每一条都是同样的链环。
chain 指末尾那一条（铁匠保留的那一条），是唯一有人认真修补过的。
chain 意为“连锁”，抽象指它承载的那条联系，父亲说 chain 就是那门生意的全部。
chain 为抽象用法，指那条联系本身，是一门生意里人人都依赖、却没人质疑的东西。
chain 意为“链条、锁链”，到 1963 年这条 chain 成了报告里的一个数字。
chain 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英尺和十一年的修补。
chain 意为“链条”，我记得的是末尾那一条，1968 年修补过，至今仍被说成全县最结实的。
chain 为抽象总称，祖母说一条链子是唯一会因为被认真修补而变好的东西。
